notes: Physical vineyard identities for the eight Vosne-Romanée / Flagey-Echezeaux Grand Cru AOCs. These records are identity and ownership metadata only. They do not create a second legal label claim because each Grand Cru name is already its own protected appellation in the strict legal-spec registry.

bourgogne_vosne_grands_crus.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne (BIVB)
bourgogne_vosne_grands_crus.scope: BIVB lists the six Vosne-Romanée Grand Crus and the two neighboring Flagey-Echezeaux Grand Crus and identifies Romanée-Conti, La Romanée, La Tâche and La Grande Rue as singly-held entities.

drc_grands_crus_current.authority: Société Civile du Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
drc_grands_crus_current.scope: Current Domaine de la Romanée-Conti vineyard portfolio, including Romanée-Conti and La Tâche.

drc_romanee_conti_current.authority: Société Civile du Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
drc_romanee_conti_current.scope: Current Romanée-Conti vineyard page; Domaine surface 1.8140 ha.

drc_la_tache_current.authority: Société Civile du Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
drc_la_tache_current.scope: Current La Tâche vineyard page; Domaine surface 6.0620 ha.

liger_belair_la_romanee_current.scope: Current Domaine vineyard page identifies La Romanée Grand Cru as a monopole and gives Domaine surface 0.8452 ha.

bourgogne_la_grande_rue_current.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne (BIVB)
bourgogne_la_grande_rue_current.scope: Current BIVB La Grande Rue page identifies the Grand Cru as a singly-held entity and reports 1.65 ha under production in 2022.

sothebys_la_grande_rue_current.scope: Current market/provenance reference states the 1.65-ha La Grande Rue vineyard belongs entirely to Domaine Nicole Lamarche. Used only for current owner metadata, not legal eligibility.

records.name: La Tâche
records.owner: Société Civile du Domaine de la Romanée-Conti
records.notes: BIVB identifies La Tâche as a singly-held Grand Cru; the current Domaine page gives 6.0620 ha. Ownership metadata is separate from the AOC production rule.
